title: Hall of Remembrance, Yad Vashem
visualBrief: Hall of Remembrance (Ohel Yizkor), Yad Vashem: exact mapped square roof on a recessed rough fieldstone base, large blank concrete fascia, continuous shadow gap, depressed inner roof and thick parapet, recessed west-end front bronze entrance and small roof floodlights. Individual faceted boulders appear nearby; all LODs keep the stone/concrete contrast and off-centre entry. Interior memorial floor, flame, names/inscriptions and site sculptures are excluded. All other Yad Vashem buildings and memorials remain separate.

The southwest exterior picture fixes the off-centre entrance at the west end of that front edge. reconstruction.terrainBasis: Reuse original Protomaps20261020 and unmodified Mapzen201x201/6m hill. Uncovered forecourt provider internal[-8,14.2], datum805.5107922282233m. Occupied floor sits0.06m above it. Cut ground only within the inset occupied base, seal it with the floor, and preserve original grade beneath the roof overhang and surrounding forecourt. A local footing meets the coarse uphill/downhill boundary; no terrace flattening, broad slab or custom terrain. Corrected native front/rear/roof/whole-site views inspected during this authoring pass. Approximate exterior fit accepted: forecourt control remains exposed and the working entry floor is0.06m above it; no broad slab, floating entrance or large exposed footing. Original coarse slope partly buries uphill lower fieldstones (boundary ground reaches2.09m above datum), so buried base portions and exact threshold/accessibility levels are not certified. Distinct History Museum and every other independent building remain unchanged. Fixed the erroneously offset roof spacer and refined stone coverage before accepting these views.
